projects.title: 3D catchment and hourly rainfall-runoff simulator
projects.summary: Delineates a hill catchment beside VIT from the Copernicus DEM, computes SCS Curve Number runoff with ERA5 hourly rainfall, routes it with the SCS unit hydrograph and a time-area model, and animates it in 3D.
projects.javaRole: Terrain analysis (Priority-Flood, D8, delineation) and all hydrological calculations, compiled to JavaScript with TeaVM and reused in the Android app.

projects.title: CivilTech Innovation Starter (template)
projects.summary: The common starting point for every team: introduction, data input and CSV upload, a Java calculation module, Chart.js, Leaflet, optional Three.js view, results table and GitHub Pages deployment.
projects.javaRole: Example calculation module (Rational Method and SCS Curve Number for campus sub-catchments) compiled to JavaScript with TeaVM.
